description: Reproducible, high-diversity model evaluation dataset for CYCLONE INTEL Qwen orchestrator and deterministic ML tools
limitations_and_scope_disclosure: This dataset contains 130 curated regression test cases drawn from the authoritative Census 2011 and multi-criteria AHP ground truth for coastal Karnataka (1,879 administrative units across Dakshina Kannada, Udupi, and Uttara Kannada). It is designed for regression gating, boundary verification, and scientific invariance enforcement. It does NOT claim statistical generalizability beyond coastal Karnataka.
